title: pancratium tubiflorum
intro: Pancratium tubiflorum, commonly known as the Sand Lily or Desert Lily, is a flowering plant species in the Amaryllidaceae family. It is native to the Indian subcontinent and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The health benefits of Pancratium tubiflorum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Pancratium tubiflorum include alkaloids such as pancratistatin and tubiflorine, which possess therapeutic actions such as anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory effects.
